name: DRA: Lunch With Jesuko
source:
The game follows Jesuko Ishinaga in her second year of IESD, International Education of Special Digital Entities.  Lunchtime has rolled around and it's time for her to decide who to eat with.  

There are ten different endings, with different ways for you to approach them depending on the choices you make. Some choices and decisions will lead you to one ending while others have one specific path for the specific ending.

[From [url=http://jaymisaeki.deviantart.com/art/DRA-VN-Lunch-With-Jesuko-369308032]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
游戏讲述了杰苏科·伊希纳加在IESD（特殊数字实体国际教育机构）就读二年级时的故事。午餐时间到了，她得决定和谁一起吃饭。

游戏共有10个不同的结局。根据你的选择，通向结局的方式也会有所不同。有些选择会将你引向某个结局，而另一些结局则只有一条特定的达成路线。

[摘自[url=http://jaymisaeki.deviantart.com/art/DRA-VN-Lunch-With-Jesuko-369308032]DeviantArt[/url]]
